answers.why: LLM.ask non-streaming create at app/llm.py:421. self.client is AsyncOpenAI(api_key, base_url) from config (app/llm.py:225); base_url is a required config field with no code default (app/config.py:21) and the shipped config/config.example.toml, which app/config.py:223 loads when config.toml is absent, points the OpenAI SDK at https://api.anthropic.com/v1/ (config.example.toml:4) with model claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219, and the other shipped example configs point at Google, PPIO, Jiekou.AI, Ollama or Azure. None of them is OpenAI's default endpoint, so rule 2 keeps it (the README's sample config at README.md:139 shows api.openai.com, but that is not the shipped default).
